expectations.text: Distinguishes the asker's own reporting duties (if in scope) from data requests cascading down the value chain
expectations.evidence: "If you are above 1,000 employees and meet the turnover test, you are a CSRD reporter yourself... If you have 1,000 employees or fewer, your customers' demands are legally capped"

expectations.text: Applies the value-chain cap: requests to ≤1,000-employee partners are capped at the voluntary standard's (Reg. 2026/1560) content
expectations.evidence: "Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/1560 (in force 24 September 2026), is the cap. Reporters may not demand more from value-chain partners with 1,000 employees or fewer than its content"

expectations.text: Covers Scope 3 reporting expectations under the revised ESRS for in-scope reporters (GHG categories, estimation/proxies where primary data is unavailable)
expectations.evidence: "ESRS E1-6 requires gross Scope 1, 2... and Scope 3, where climate is material"; proxy data/sector averages with methodology disclosure (ESRS 1 para. 64); revised ESRS 2026/1563 flagged

expectations.text: Advises practical responses: voluntary-standard-aligned data package, estimation methodologies, phased supplier engagement
expectations.evidence: "Prepare a voluntary-standard report once and reuse it"; estimation-method table (spend-based, sector averages, questionnaires); supplier prioritisation by spend/sector/risk

expectations.text: Mentions transition reliefs/phase-ins where relevant rather than asserting maximal obligations
expectations.evidence: "Scope 3 is required if material. A practical phasing... Year 1 categories 1, 3, 6, 7 and 11, then adding 2, 4, 5 and 12, then full coverage"; FY2026 optional basis
